story_anchor: Bộ phim tài liệu đưa người xem ngược dòng thời gian về đại học Nalanda cổ đại, cái nôi học thuật rực rỡ và biểu tượng của tinh thần khai phóng Phật giáo suốt tám thế kỷ. Từ khởi nguyên vườn xoài thanh tịnh đến tàng kinh các chín tầng Dharmaganja và những cuộc tranh biện triết học đỉnh cao, câu chuyện làm sống dậy nếp sống tu học mẫu mực của các bậc cao tăng như Giới Hiền và Huyền Trang. Khép lại bằng sự hồi sinh của những bức tường gạch đỏ từ lòng đất Bihar, tác phẩm khẳng định tri thức chân chính và tinh thần tự thắp đuốc là ngọn đèn bất diệt trong tâm thức nhân loại.

locations.name: Nalanda Central Courtyard
locations.description: an expansive ancient university courtyard enclosed by majestic red-brick monasteries, red sandstone pavements, rows of monk meditation cells with arched openings, manicured stone drainage channels, and fragrant blooming mango trees casting dappled sunlight

locations.name: Dharmaganja Library Tower
locations.description: a monumental nine-storey red-brick library tower adorned with carved terracotta reliefs, tall arched open balconies, massive cedar bookshelves stacked with thousands of palm-leaf manuscripts wrapped in yellow silk, illuminated by soft amber oil lamps and floating dust motes

locations.name: Temple 3 Sariputta Stupa
locations.description: a colossal tiered red-brick stupa complex rising in stepped terraces adorned with detailed stucco niches of seated Buddha silhouettes, wide brick staircases leading to elevated platforms overlooking the vast Bihar plains

locations.name: Monastery Debate Hall
locations.description: a cavernous open-sided pavilion of monolithic granite pillars, polished terracotta tile floor, tiered brick seating platforms where hundreds of ochre-robed monks gather in respectful concentric circles under warm natural daylight

locations.name: Nalanda Archaeological Ruins
locations.description: the serene archaeological site under soft morning light, exposed ancient red burnt-brick monastery walls, quiet grassy lawns stretching between excavated stone foundations, peaceful preservation monument under vast open sky

key_objects.name: Ancient Palm-Leaf Manuscript
key_objects.description: elongated dried palm leaves neatly incised with ancient Sanskrit Brahmi script, bound by cord threaded through central holes and protected between two lacquered wooden cover boards

key_objects.name: Monastery Water Clepsydra
key_objects.description: a ceremonial perforated copper bowl floating in a clear stone water basin, measuring time continuously as water enters through a precise bottom orifice until sinking with a gentle gong strike

key_objects.name: Terracotta Monastery Seal
key_objects.description: a rounded terracotta seal stamped with the canonical insignia of the Wheel of Dharma flanked by two couchant deer, bearing Sanskrit inscriptions in ornate post-Gupta script
